entities.name: Columbian Exchange
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The massive transfer of plants, animals, diseases, and human populations between the Old and New Worlds following 1492. Potatoes, maize, and tomatoes transformed European and Asian diets; horses and wheat reshaped the Americas; while smallpox, measles, and influenza killed an estimated 90% of indigenous Americans. The most consequential ecological event since the end of the Ice Age.
